work_orders.title: Cold weather watch: methanol injection at max rate

notes.text: 3 PM: Methanol pump set to max for the cold snap. Scrubber dumping more often than normal today.
5 PM day shift: heat trace on the instrument rack and sensing lines checked earlier this week (runs on utility power). Discharge PSVs on all units are set at 1200 psig.

dispatch_jobs.reason: Station utility power failure at ~18:04 during -8F cold snap. Instrument rack and sensing-line heat trace runs on utility power and is now off; high risk of frozen sensing lines/transmitters (pressure, scrubber level) leaving protective shutdowns blind. PLC on UPS (limited duration). Need restore power/temporary heat and field-verify instruments.

ADDITIONAL TASK for TECH-1 already on site (not a new call-out if possible): inlet scrubber level rising ~0.8%/min since 18:06, now 78%, auto dump appears frozen/not operating. Please check/thaw scrubber dump valve and level controller and drain scrubber manually before liquid carryover to units.
